name: Research Pipeline
description:
Software-domain researcher arc with source-repo substrate via semsource. Coordinator instantiates with a topic; researcher plans, gathers, synthesizes; reviewer-research approves and replies to the user.

Phase 2a skeleton — body is a valid flow shape that passes Flow.Validate but does not yet wire the agentic components. Phase 2b expands the body to include agentic-dispatch / agentic-loop / agentic-tools / agentic-memory / graph-ingest / rule-processor nodes mirroring the legacy configs/dev-research.json topology, with parameter substitution at the LLM-author-controllable knobs only.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Human-readable research topic. Shown in the flow name and description.

parameters.name: topic_slug
parameters.description: Kebab-case slug of the topic. Used in the flow ID. Coordinator derives from topic.

parameters.name: max_iterations
parameters.description: Maximum researcher loop iterations before terminal. Higher for deep research, lower for quick lookups.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: LLM endpoint name from the model_registry. claude-haiku is the cost-effective default; bump to claude-sonnet for harder topics.
